findings: `formation.text` says that in 號, 虎 has the “meaning role,” but does not explain its specific contribution; `history[3]` also describes the disputed tiger-roar picture without stating the supported traditional analysis of 號 as 号 (sound) + 虎 (meaning). Clarify that, in this traditional analysis, 虎 contributes the idea of a loud or fierce cry, while the alternative tiger-with-exhaled-air origin remains a separate uncertain proposal. Cite `X-2b6bc3c1213e6ac8ed5b` and `X-77e31e3f454cce6b91e0`.
